articles.body:
Microservices architecture has become increasingly popular, but it's not a silver bullet. This guide will help you understand when and how to implement microservices effectively.

## What are Microservices?
Microservices are an architectural style that structures an application as a collection of loosely coupled services...

## Benefits
- Independent deployment
- Technology diversity
- Fault isolation
- Scalability
articles.description: Understanding microservices patterns and when to use them
articles.title: Microservices Architecture Guide
